gaps.explanation: Statement lines are the accrual Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds Totals (pp9-10, printed pp14-15): Charges for services 685,819 + Lease agreement 257,243 + Miscellaneous 5,011 + Interest revenue 91,851 = 1,039,924. Schedule 28 'Actual Accrual Basis Compared to Budgetary Cash Basis' (p35, printed p68) prints the same accrual receipts per fund: Electric 347,450 (262,753 + 84,697) + Water 389,842 (384,389 + 5,453) + Sewer 302,632 (300,931 + 1,701) = 1,039,924. The detail lines come from Schedule 29 Actual Budgetary Basis (p36, printed p69): Electric 350,941 + Water revenue part 394,184 (Receipts: Water 890,116 less the 495,932 interfund 'Due Froms', recorded as other financing) + Sewer 299,504 = 1,044,629. The difference is exactly Schedule 28's '(Increase)/Decrease For Accruals Receivables' column: Electric 3,491 + Water 4,342 + Sewer (3,128) = 4,705 (1,039,924 + 4,705 = 1,044,629). Basis difference printed by the report; no line missing or doubled.

Statement (pp9-10, accrual): Production and purchased power 49,782 + Maintenance and operation 190,808 + General 13,975 + Administrative 106,237 + Depreciation 251,369 + Interest expense 7,542 = 619,713 = Schedule 28 (p35) Disbursements Accrual Basis Electric 85,425 + Water 238,942 + Sewer 295,346. Detail expenditure lines are Schedule 29 (p36) budgetary cash basis: Water 155,541 + Sewer 257,838 = 413,379; Schedule 29 'Disbursements: Electric' 771,288 is recorded in detail as other financing because Schedule 28 shows it is entirely the interfund 'Inc (Dec) Prepaids/Due To' 771,288 (Electric accrual 85,425 is all depreciation, removed by (85,425)). Schedule 28 reconciles each fund exactly: Water 238,942 + payables 1,242 - depreciation 99,059 + debt princ/int 14,416 = 155,541; Sewer 295,346 + 4,298 - 66,885 + 25,079 = 257,838. Gap 206,334 = depreciation 251,369 - payables (1,242 + 4,298) 5,540 - debt principal/interest (14,416 + 25,079) 39,495. Basis difference printed by the report; no line missing or doubled.
